QtAwesome 1.4.2 font redistribution notices
Recorded: 2026-10-27

The application uses Font Awesome 5 Solid for interface controls. QtAwesome's
standard runtime also carries the following unmodified font files and charmaps.
The original font binaries retain their embedded names and attribution fields.
No brand glyph implies endorsement by its owner.

Copyright (c) Font Awesome (as embedded in the shipped fonts).
Fonticons, Inc. / Font Awesome: https://fontawesome.com/
Font files: SIL Open Font License 1.1; non-font charmaps/code: MIT.
See the two upstream Font-Awesome LICENSE files; 6.7.2 includes full OFL text.
The separate original SIL OFL template is included verbatim for completeness;
its placeholder copyright fields are part of the publisher's original template,
not assertions about this application or replacement font copyright notices.
